transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

My mind keeps jumping to every little thing around me, and I can’t stay focused on what I’m supposed to be doing anymore. It's gotten to the point where I'm really struggling to get through my workday because I keep getting sidetracked by everything.
Did these focus and distraction problems start when you were a child or teenager, or are they new in adulthood? Also, do you remember having similar problems in school?

No, I don't remember having any issues like this when I was a kid or back in school. These focus problems are completely new and only started about seven months ago when I transitioned into my new regional freight sales job. Before that, I never had trouble staying on task.
Have you had any recent changes in sleep, mood, anxiety, or major stressors around the time these concentration problems started?

Yes, it started seven months ago when I transitioned from long-haul driving to regional sales, and I've also been dealing with anxiety. Since then, I only sleep three or four hours a night but wake up completely wired with energy. My mood swings constantly too, going from feeling on top of the world and talking a mile a minute to snapping instantly at my wife or boss.
Have you had times lasting several days when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt unusually energized, confident, or more talkative than normal?

Yes, this has been happening constantly over the last seven months. I only sleep three or four hours a night but wake up wired, feeling incredibly confident that I can easily double our company's sales while running my own side businesses. I end up talking a mile a minute to customers and jumping from one project to another like I've got a motor running inside me that won't shut off.
Have these periods of high energy, decreased need for sleep, and racing from one idea to another lasted at least 4 days in a row at a time, or have they been present most days for months?

They've been present almost every single day for the last seven months, ever since I started this new regional sales job. It’s not just a phase that lasts a few days at a time; it has been an ongoing, daily struggle this entire time.
Have you ever felt unusually suspicious, heard or seen things that other people couldn’t, or had beliefs that others said were unrealistic while this was going on?

No, I haven't seen or heard things that aren't there, and I don't feel suspicious of anyone. But my wife and my boss have definitely told me my plans are unrealistic, because I genuinely felt I was the only one who could turn our sales region around while easily running side photography and woodworking businesses, even though I was falling behind on my actual work.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least 4 days when you felt unusually energized or overly confident with much less sleep than usual, or has this been happening most days for months without a break?

It’s definitely been happening most days for the past seven months, ever since I transitioned to this regional sales job, rather than just a short stretch. During this entire time, I've consistently slept only three to four hours a night while feeling wired, highly energized, and overly confident that I could turn the company's sales around and handle all my side projects.
Have you ever had a time when these high-energy, overconfident symptoms were severe enough to cause major problems at work or with relationships, or did they last at least 4 days in a row?

Yes, it has caused major problems for the last seven months, far longer than just four days. At work, I nearly lost a key account and my boss warned me about my erratic hours and overpromising. At home, my wife is furious because I've been missing family events and running up credit card debt on equipment for projects I can't seem to finish.
Have you ever had a clearly defined period of at least 1 week when you felt unusually elevated or irritable with much more energy than usual, even if it caused problems at work or at home?

Yes, I've been feeling exactly like that for about seven months now since I changed jobs, which is way longer than just a week. I constantly swing from feeling on top of the world with endless energy to start multiple projects, to getting instantly furious if anyone questions me. It has caused massive problems, like nearly losing a major work account and having terrible arguments at home with my wife.
During these past seven months, have you also had any periods of feeling depressed, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really felt depressed or lost interest in things during this time. If anything, I've felt the complete opposite—extremely busy, wired, and easily frustrated rather than down. I'm usually way too wound up and active to feel hopeless.

Have you ever had a distinct period of at least 1 week where you felt unusually elevated or very irritable with much more energy than usual, or have these symptoms been present almost every day for months?

It’s definitely been happening almost every single day for the past seven months since I changed jobs, rather than just a single week. I constantly feel like I have a motor running inside me that won't shut off, driving me to jump from one thing to the next. My mood swings between feeling on top of the world and snapping at people have been a persistent, daily struggle during this entire time.

Have you ever had a clearly defined episode of feeling unusually elevated or irritable with much more energy than usual that lasted at least 4 days in a row, or have these symptoms been present most days for months without a break?

It has definitely been happening almost every day for about seven months now, rather than just a short four-day episode. Ever since I transitioned to my regional freight sales job, I've been constantly on the go like a motor is running inside me, swinging between feeling on top of the world and snapping at others.
Have you ever had a clearly defined period of at least 4 days when these symptoms were much worse than usual, or have they been present almost every day for months without a break?

It's been an ongoing, escalating issue almost every day for about seven months since I started my new job, rather than just a brief four-day phase. While I have some ups and downs, it has been a constant daily struggle with high energy, racing thoughts, and barely any sleep. It has just been a continuous pattern ever since the transition.

Have you ever had a separate episode in the past of at least 1 week where you felt unusually high, irritable, or energetic with much less sleep than usual, even before this current seven-month period?

No, I haven't really experienced anything like this before this current seven-month period. While I might have had normal ups and downs in the past, nothing has ever been this intense, long-lasting, or disruptive to my life before I switched to this new sales job.
Before this current seven-month period, have you ever had a separate episode lasting at least 4 days where you felt unusually energized, overly confident, or needed much less sleep than usual?
I don't recall ever having an episode like that before the last seven months. These issues really only started after I transitioned to the new regional sales job.
Have you ever had any past episodes of depression, or any other periods of unusually high energy or irritability that lasted several days or longer before these last seven months?

No, I don't recall having any past episodes of depression or periods of high energy like this before. These problems really only started ramping up and causing trouble over the last seven months since I switched jobs.
Have you ever had a time before these last seven months when you had a clear manic or hypomanic episode, or any period of depression, even if it was years ago?
No, I don't recall ever having any episodes like this or periods of depression prior to these last seven months. My struggles really only started after my job transition.
Have your high-energy, overconfident, and irritable symptoms ever come in clear episodes with a return to your usual self in between, or have they been present nearly every day since they started?

They have been pretty constant and ramping up almost every day since I started the new job seven months ago. I haven't had any distinct episodes where I returned to my usual self in between. It has just been one continuous, difficult stretch.
Have these symptoms ever come in clear episodes with a return to your usual self in between, or have they been present nearly every day since they started?

Like I said, they haven't come in separate episodes with any normal breaks in between. Ever since I transitioned to this regional sales job seven months ago, these struggles have been pretty much constant and steadily getting worse. I haven't had any periods where I felt completely back to my normal self.
Have you ever had any separate episodes in the past where these symptoms completely went away and then later came back, or have they truly been present almost every day since they started?

They have truly been present almost every single day since they started. It has just been one continuous, steadily ramping-up struggle over the last seven months since my job transition, rather than coming and going in separate episodes.
Have you ever had a separate period in the past when your mood and energy were clearly back to normal for at least a few weeks, or has this been one continuous problem since it started?

It has been one continuous, ramping struggle ever since I switched to the regional freight sales job about seven months ago. Before that transition, when I was doing long-haul driving, my life and mood were much more stable. Since this started, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to normal for a few weeks—it has just been an ongoing, escalating rollercoaster.
Have you started or increased any substances or medications around the time this began, such as stimulants, steroids, energy drinks, cocaine, or other drugs?
No, I haven't started or increased any medications, stimulants, steroids, energy drinks, or other drugs around the time this all started. I don't use any substances like that.
Have you ever had a past episode of depression or a clearly defined manic/hypomanic episode before this current 7-month period, even if it was years ago?

I don't recall having any clear episodes of depression or intense highs like this before this past seven-month period. I have had some general anxiety in the past, but nothing like these extreme mood swings or high energy.
Have you ever had any hallucinations or felt suspicious that other people were trying to harm or control you during this period?

No, I haven't experienced any hallucinations or felt like people are trying to harm or control me. However, I do get instantly furious and frustrated when others try to restrict me or "chain me down" when they question my plans.
Have you ever had a separate period of at least 2 weeks when you felt depressed, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, I've never really experienced a period of feeling depressed, hopeless, or losing interest in things. My struggles have actually been the exact opposite—having way too much energy, a racing mind, and feeling easily irritated or wired. I'm usually way too keyed up to ever feel down like that.
Have you ever had any separate periods in the past when these high-energy or irritable symptoms fully went away and then came back later, or has it truly been one continuous problem since it started?

It has truly been one continuous problem since it started. Ever since I transitioned to my new sales job seven months ago, these symptoms have just kept ramping up without any breaks or separate episodes where they went away and came back.
Have you ever had a period like this before that lasted at least 2 years with only brief periods of feeling normal, or has this been only a single continuous 7-month stretch?

No, I've never had any long, multi-year periods of these symptoms in the past. This is the very first time I've ever experienced anything like this, and it has been a single, continuous seven-month stretch since I transitioned to my regional freight sales job.
Before these last seven months, did you ever have a period of at least 2 years when you felt mildly depressed or low most of the time, with only brief times feeling normal?

No, I don't recall ever having a long, two-year period of feeling mildly depressed or low in the past before these recent changes started. Before I switched to this regional sales job, my mood was generally pretty stable and I didn't have those kinds of long-term lows.
Before these last seven months, did you ever have a period of at least 2 years when you felt mildly depressed or low most of the time, with only brief times feeling normal?

No, I've never experienced a long, two-year stretch of feeling constantly down or depressed prior to these recent months. I have dealt with some anxiety in the past, but never that kind of chronic low mood.
Before these last seven months, did you ever have a period of at least 2 years when you felt mildly depressed or low most of the time, with only brief times feeling normal?

I really don't recall ever having a long period like that where I felt low or depressed for years at a time before these recent changes. Prior to my job transition, my mood was generally pretty stable.
